description: Exact reconstitution math for a single-peptide vial: insulin syringe units for a dose, concentration after adding bacteriostatic water and doses per vial, or the dose held in a given number of units. Flags likely mg/mcg mix-ups against the peptide's published range. Returns a calculator link.

dose.description: Dose amount, e.g. 250 with doseUnit mcg. Give dose OR unitsDrawn.

doseUnit.description: Unit of the dose (mcg, mg or IU). Required with dose; with unitsDrawn it picks the unit of the answer.

peptide.description: Optional peptide name. Adds its IU factor, a range check and its published injected ranges.

syringe.description: Insulin syringe type. "U-100" (the common 1 mL / 0.5 mL / 0.3 mL insulin syringe) unless the user says otherwise.

unitsDrawn.description: Syringe units drawn, to get the dose they hold. Give dose OR unitsDrawn.

vialAmount.description: Amount of peptide in the vial, e.g. 10 for a 10 mg vial.

vialUnit.description: Unit of the vial amount: mg for nearly every peptide, IU for HGH-type vials.

waterMl.description: Bacteriostatic water added to the vial, in mL, e.g. 2.

name: peptide_reconstitution_calculator
title: Reconstitution and syringe units
